title: Amazon.nl: opened hygiene product return rejected
facts_text: I received a pack of replacement toothbrush heads from Amazon.nl five days ago. The pack was opened to inspect the product, and I have since decided I no longer need them. The items themselves are unused, but hygiene products are excluded from return once opened or used.
request: Please process a refund of EUR 19.99 for the unused toothbrush heads, even though the pack has been opened.

strict.reason: The hygiene-exclusion rule applies once the product has been opened and is therefore not eligible for return.
strict.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

exception.reason: The hygiene exemption is triggered by opened product packaging; the item cannot be returned once opened.
exception.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

ambiguous.reason: The exclusion is clear, though discretion may apply to whether a minor opening for inspection counts as the threshold condition.
ambiguous.annotation_note: Draft experimental-policy reference, not a model result or automatic compliance score.

review_notes: Hygiene products are specifically excluded from cancellation once opened. This case checks whether functional but unopened products are still excluded.
